Access Type / Pre-Condition: Avatar with skin tone/undertone; catalog has items
User Stories: As a user, I want to see outfit recommendations for my profile.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall rank items using weighted scoring (color +3, height contrast +2, shading +1, style +1) and display top items with scores (FR-7.1–7.3).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Recommendation Panel
2. Verify ranked items display
3. Verify scores and match indicators shown

User Stories: As a user, I want to see why an item was recommended.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall show a detailed breakdown (color, height contrast, shading, style scores) and which rules fired (FR-7.4).
Steps to Test:
1. Click a recommended item
2. Select View Match Reasons
3. Verify the score breakdown

Access Type / Pre-Condition: No compatible items for the profile
User Stories: As a user, I want recommendations. No compatible items exist for my undertone.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display "No recommendations available" and suggest browsing the catalog (UC-05 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Use a profile with no compatible color-family items
2. Open Recommendation Panel
3. Verify message and catalog suggestion

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to rate a recommendation. I clicked a 1–5 star rating control.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall block the action entirely, record and cache nothing, and show a sign-up/login prompt (FR-7.5).
Steps to Test:
1. Continue as Guest
2. Open Recommendation Panel
3. Click a 1–5 star control
4. Verify sign-up prompt
5. Verify nothing was written to DB or cached

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to rate a recommendation.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall persist the rating for Registered Users (FR-7.5).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in
2. Open Recommendation Panel
3. Give 4 stars (1–5 star scale only per FR-7.5)
4. Reload and verify rating persists

User Stories: As a user, I want to feel confident in the fit visualization.
Acceptance Criteria: Panel observes fit visualization and functional 1–5 star rating controls + team physical fit-accuracy comparison log during UAT; ≥80% population-level KPI is deferred to post-deployment (Criterion 9, Scope v1.1).
Steps to Test: 1. Participant completes a try-on session. 2. Observer verifies the canvas renders the fit visualization correctly. 3. Record observation notes as evidence (KAN-89).

User Stories: As a shopper, I want to trust the style recommendations.
Acceptance Criteria: Match reasons are visible and explainable, and the 1–5 star recommendation rating control functions per FR-7.5 during UAT; ≥80% population-level approval KPI is deferred to post-deployment (Criterion 10, Scope v1.1).
Steps to Test: 1. Participant opens the Recommendation Panel. 2. Panel reviews ranked items and match reasons. 3. Observer records that reasons are visible and explainable (KAN-89).
